name: io.github.biztory/biztory-tableau-knowledge-mcp
description: Search, explore and enrich the Tableau Knowledge graph, and port it to Apache Ossie (OSI).

environmentVariables.name: TABLEAU_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: https://<pod>.online.tableau.com (Tableau Knowledge is a Tableau Cloud feature)

environmentVariables.name: TABLEAU_PAT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Personal Access Token secret (the whole string)

environmentVariables.name: TABLEAU_KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default graph id; empty = the site's primary graph

environmentVariables.name: TABLEAU_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: DEBUG, INFO (default), WARNING or ERROR; DEBUG logs each HTTP call (method + URL) to stderr
